q2: SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN TOTAL_COUNT = 1 THEN NUM ELSE NULL END) AS NUM FROM ( SELECT NUM, COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_COUNT FROM MYNUMBERS GROUP BY 1 ) A

explanation: Q1 finds the maximum number among those that appear exactly once in MYNUMBERS. Q2 uses a CASE expression to return NULL for numbers that appear more than once, but it also returns NULL for numbers that appear once if MAX is applied across all rows (which includes NULLs, so MAX ignores them). This can lead to different results when multiple numbers appear once.
